key_decisions: PAINT PERSISTS PER ENTRY, and the TEMP store is SESSION-SCOPED. main.js deletes MASK_TEMP_ROOT on quit and prunes stale dirs at boot, so paint survives an entry switch, a tool switch and a renderer reload — but NOT a quit and relaunch. Masks have always behaved this way. The plan's original 'Reload the app: still there' line was wrong and is corrected in Plan Drift.

PERSIST WRITES OR DELETES, never just writes. The mask layers get their stale copy dropped by clearMask()'s TEMP delete; paint has no such twin, so a write-only persist would resurrect a cleared layer on the next visit to that entry.

mask-temp:delete IS NO LONGER A DIRECTORY NUKE. It removes manual.png, subtract.png and auto.json by name. paint.png shares that dir and is not a mask, so a dir-wide rm would have made Clear mask wipe the paint layer. A test guard fails if anyone restores rmSync(dir, ...).

APPLY IS A SIBLING ROUTE, NOT A MODE OF composite-media. That route blends two project FILES through a mask; paint has neither — one file plus an RGBA layer carrying its own alpha. Only the surrounding machinery is shared. Destabilising MPI-362's shipped blend to save a route was the wrong trade.

APPLY HONOURS THE OPACITY SLIDER (changed on the user's request, 2026-08-03). The server scales the FLATTENED layer's alpha once, which is the same maths as the canvas drawing at globalAlpha. Applied layer-wide, not per dab, so overlapping dabs in one stroke cannot bake darker than the rest — which is why this does NOT reopen the refused per-stroke-alpha decision.

UNDO DOES NOT SURVIVE AN ENTRY SWITCH, and the user accepted this as correct. docs/masking-undo.md: the stack is cleared on any LOAD — mask.init(), i.e. every loadImage, i.e. every entry switch — and again in _restoreLayers(). The mask brush has always done this; paint shares the one stack. The user's reasoning: consistent with the mask, and the less VRAM the better. Do NOT card it.
ONE UndoStack, chronological, shared by mask and paint. Ctrl+Z inside Paint can walk back into a mask stroke. Documented, deliberate, ruled on before undo was built.
AGENTS DO NOT EDIT WORKFLOW JSON (unchanged). The user edits comfy_workflows/raw/ by hand; the agent produces the LIST (raw file, node id, widget INDEX) and runs scripts/sync-raw-workflows.mjs.
